import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('customer360.db')

# Execute the INNER JOIN query across the three tables
query = """
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.signup_date,
    t.transaction_id,
    t.transaction_date,
    t.amount,
    t.product_category,
    i.interaction_id,
    i.interaction_date,
    i.interaction_type,
    i.channel
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
INNER JOIN interactions i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, t.transaction_date, i.interaction_date
"""

# Display the first few rows of the joined data

print("\nFirst 5 rows of joined data:")
print(joined_data.head())

# Close the connection
conn.close()

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('customer360.db')

# Execute the INNER JOIN query across the three tables
query = """
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.signup_date,
    t.transaction_id,
    t.transaction_date,
    t.amount,
    t.product_category,
    i.interaction_id,
    i.interaction_date,
    i.interaction_type,
    i.channel
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
INNER JOIN interactions i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, t.transaction_date, i.interaction_date
"""

# Execute the query and load results into a DataFrame
joined_data = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

# Display the first few rows of the joined data
print("Joined data shape:", joined_data.shape)
print("\nFirst 5 rows of joined data:")
print(joined_data.head())

# Close the connection
conn.close()

108,1,180.25,2023-06-08,Electronics
109,3,95.00,2023-06-09,Clothing
110,4,210.00,2023-06-10,Furniture"""

# Create DataFrames from the sample data

transactions_df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(transaction_data))

transactions_df.to_sql('transactions', conn, if_exists='replace', index=False)

query = """

    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.segment,
    c.join_date,
    t.transaction_id,
    t.amount,
    t.date as transaction_date,
    t.product_category
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, t.date
"""

conn.close()
